info.title: Vextorium — pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents
info.description: On-chain data (12 EVM chains, Solana, Tron, TON), DeFi, tokenized stocks, prediction markets, official economic statistics, web, data and developer tools. No accounts or API keys: pay per call in USDC with x402.
info.x-guidance: Start here by task: trading bots → /v1/new-safe-tokens, /v1/token-safety-batch (25 tokens per call), /v1/pre-trade-check, then /v1/position-check and /v1/token-price-batch while holding; wallet due diligence → /v1/wallet-identity and /v1/wallet-sanctions-check; market context → /v1/market-regime; macro → /v1/economic-calendar. Full workflows: https://api.vextorium.com/llms.txt. Every operation is a POST with a JSON body (see each requestBody example). The first call returns HTTP 402 with the x402 v2 challenge; pay in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on XRPL and retry the same request. Only successful (200) responses are charged; invalid input (4xx) or an unavailable upstream source (5xx) is never charged. Machine-readable catalog with real example outputs: https://api.vextorium.com/catalog.json. MCP server: https://api.vextorium.com/mcp
